senses.gloss:
Aupoditi, ‘descendant of Upodita,’ is the patronymic applied
in the Taittirīya Saṃhitā^1 to Tumiñja, and in the Baudhāyana
Śrauta Sūtra^2 to Gaupālāyana, son of Vyāghrapad, Sthapati
(‘general’) of the Kurus. In the form of Aupoditeya, a metro-
nymic from Upoditā, the name is found in the Śatapatha
Brāhmaṇa,^3 where the Kāṇva text calls him Tumiñja Aupo-
diteya Vaiyāghrapadya.
1) i. 7, 2, 1.
2) xx. 25.
3) i. 9, 3. 16.
Cf. Eggeling, Sacred Books of the East.
12, 271, n. 2.
